# Heliox OS Source Repository

> Heliox OS is an open-source desktop AI system-control agent. This index routes language models and coding agents to the repository's authoritative product, architecture, safety, and contribution documentation.

Important interpretation notes:

- Heliox OS is a desktop application, not an operating-system kernel or a replacement for Windows, macOS, or Linux.
- The published v0.16.0 installers declare 162 action types across 21 executable specialists. Provider coverage does not establish universal host availability or independent outcome verification.
- Commands run through typed permissions, confirmation gates, verification, and recovery controls; documentation must not imply unrestricted autonomy.
- Neural-intent support is research infrastructure. Synthetic and recorded-EEG tests do not establish live brain control, human accuracy, medical use, or clinical efficacy.
- Local-first features can still call explicitly configured model or integration providers. Current `main` supports local Ollama plus Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Claude, and Meta adapters. OpenRouter accepts exact catalog model IDs, including current DeepSeek IDs; this is not a claim that every catalog model is a separately integrated backend. Consult the privacy and security documents before making data-handling claims.

## Start Here

- [Project README](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/README.md): Product overview, installation, capability catalog, development setup, and current release information.
- [Website Agent Index](https://www.helioxos.dev/llms.txt): Machine-readable index for the public Heliox OS website.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Runtime components, request flow, agent boundaries, memory, learning, and deployment architecture.
- [Security](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Threat model, credential handling, permissions, reporting process, and supported versions.

## Runtime and Extension Contracts

- [Machine-readable Capability Catalog](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/capabilities.json): Generated actions, platform declarations, permission and approval requirements, specialist providers, verifier coverage, and plugin manifests.
- [IPC Message Formats](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/IPC_MESSAGE_FORMATS.md): Desktop-to-daemon request, event, approval, and result contracts.
- [Agent Development Guide](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/AGENT_DEVELOPMENT_GUIDE.md): Specialist-agent conventions and extension workflow.
- [Action Catalog Source](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/daemon/pilot/actions.py): Canonical typed action declarations used by the runtime.
- [Plugin Marketplace](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/tree/main/plugins): Reviewed plugin packages and marketplace catalog.

## Safety and Evidence Boundaries

- [Evidence and Limitations](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/proof.md): Generated action coverage, live CI links, measured local latency, hardware claim boundaries, known limitations, and representative closed regressions.
- [Current software benchmark bundle](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/docs/evidence/software-benchmarks-2026-10-26.json): v0.16.0 measurements from 26 October 2026, including the built-in command suite (91/91 commands answered in code), with the measured source commit, host environment, sample counts and exclusions.
- [Security: undo, receipts, timeline and your data](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Per-task undo computed in code (never by a model), Ed25519-signed hash-chained task receipts, the opt-in activity timeline (names and titles only, never pixels or screen text), focus sessions that never hold approvals, phone requests the phone can never approve, and backups that never include settings, tokens or keys.
- [Security: lists, watchers, clipboard and helpers](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/SECURITY.md): The v0.16.0 built-in commands run no action; watchers only look; clipboard history is opt-in and memory-only; text that looks like a password or key is never kept, saved or read aloud; generated passwords go to the clipboard only.
- [Assistance co-adaptation](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/docs/COADAPTATION.md): Opt-in selection study, purpose-specific consent, presentation-only authority and simulated-user evidence. Tuning-family results do not establish an improvement for real people.
- [Neural Intent](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/docs/NEURAL_INTENT.md): Synthetic-board, recorded-EEG, provenance, calibration, and live-hardware claim boundaries.
- [Security Policy](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Supported security controls and responsible disclosure.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Required checks, review process, and contribution expectations.
